The rank-two same-orbit indices 2 vs 4 are checked by exhaustive minors, not by sampling. Real-cone assertion follows by group averaging. An earlier separate Smith form calculation corroborated the spectrum; the full reproducible checker is embedded.

Exact classification across all Weyl types identifies a sharp index 16. The equal 4^4 orbit-zeta and equal rank-two contrast shows a structural arithmetic invariant invisible to line zeta and rational Picard data. Not a routine reparametrization or unmotivated isolated field count.
